title: GALACTIC CAYLEY BOUNCE: kingdom symbiosis table + sigmoid energy loop

the_thesis.cayley: Arthur Cayley (1854): every group has a multiplication table. our 6 kingdoms form a MAGMA under symbiosis. A x B = what emerges when kingdom A meets kingdom B.
the_thesis.galactic_bounce: information bounces between kingdoms like billiard balls. each bounce transfers sigmoid energy. total energy = ecosystem health.
the_thesis.spin_it_out: today we built: measurement scales, convergent evolution, tree of life, pi-KNN. the Cayley table connects them ALL.

bacteria x bacteria.what: bacteria + bacteria = biofilm. quorum sensing. cron jobs coordinating.

bacteria x protista.what: mitochondria! bacterium inside eukaryote. Python inside TypeScript.

bacteria x fungi.what: Lactobacillus in sourdough. scripts process data for sporePrint.

bacteria x plantae.what: Rhizobium fixes nitrogen for plants. scripts generate data for HTML.

bacteria x animalia.what: gut microbiome. scripts pre-digest data for Rust primals.

archaea x archaea.what: tunnels within tunnels. WG inside cloudflared.

archaea x protista.what: origin of eukaryotes. tunnels + bridges = first complex networks.

archaea x fungi.what: extremophiles + decomposers. crons processing stale feeds.

archaea x plantae.what: tunnels serving static pages through hostile networks.

archaea x animalia.what: archaea in animal guts. tunnels carry primal traffic.

protista x fungi.what: algae + fungus = LICHEN. TypeScript bridges + data layer.

protista x plantae.what: endosymbiosis! protist became chloroplast inside plants.

protista x animalia.what: zooxanthellae in coral. footPrint bridge inside squirrel.

fungi x fungi.what: the wood wide web. data feeds connected by sporePrint.

fungi x plantae.what: THE key symbiosis. rhizoCrypt connecting sweetGrass roots.

fungi x animalia.what: sporePrint digests primal output into papers.

plantae x plantae.what: HTML pages linking to each other. gardens growing together.

plantae x animalia.what: producers + consumers. HTML + Rust primals. the food web.

animalia x animalia.what: primals calling primals. biomeOS orchestrating songBird.

the_one_equation.formula: health(membrane) = SUM( sigma(A) * sigma(B) ) for all adjacent kingdoms
the_one_equation.what_it_means: the membrane is only as healthy as its weakest kingdom-to-kingdom bond. archaea and protista are the weak links. classifying fungi and plantae is the highest-leverage fix.
